svg.title: Solute particles
svg.desc: Two solution diagrams use identical dots for the same solute. Diagram 1 is labelled 100 mL and contains eight dots; diagram 2 is labelled 200 mL and contains sixteen dots. Diagram 1 contains eight solute particles in a box representing 100 mL of solution. Diagram 2 contains sixteen particles of the same solute in a box representing 200 mL. Dots have the same size in both diagrams. The boxes are schematic; the printed volumes are the stated solution volumes. No concentration comparison is labelled.

g.text: Each dot represents a solute particle.
